Large Files Excluded from GitHub Pages

⚠️ Some files were too large to be included in the GitHub Pages deployment

GitHub has a 100MB file size limit for regular Git repositories. The files listed below exceeded this limit and were excluded from the deployment.

📋 Access Complete Artifacts

You can access the complete test results, including these large files, from the GitHub Actions artifacts.

The artifacts are stored for 90 days and contain all test results, including videos, traces, and screenshots.

To download the artifacts:

  1. Go to the GitHub Actions run page (link below)
  2. Scroll down to the "Artifacts" section
  3. Download the artifact that includes your files of interest

Note: Large video and trace files are typically most useful for debugging test failures.
